content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I look forward to working together and have a couple of suggestions before signing. - Regarding the scope of services, the agreement currently requires me to perform unspecified extra work without a change-order mechanism or additional compensation. I propose that any additional services outside the scope of Schedule A be set forth in a written change order specifying the additional fees and terms agreed upon by both parties. - Regarding intellectual property, the current clause assigns all rights immediately upon creation before full payment is received. I propose that upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, the contractor assigns to the client all right, title, and interest in and to the final deliverables created specifically for the client under this agreement. Please let me know if these updates work for you. Best regards.
